questions.markdown: Describe the operation of n-channel enhancement mode MOSFET along with V-I characteristics. Also derive the drain current of MOSFET in terms of $V_{GS}$, $V_{DS}$, and the dimension of the device.

A silicon diode has reverse saturation current of 15 nA at 25$^{\circ}$C. Determine the voltage required to get a forward current of 6 mA at 35$^{\circ}$C. Also determine the static and dynamic resistance of the diode at 40$^{\circ}$C.
Explain Avalanche breakdown and Zener breakdown mechanisms in diode.

An AC voltage of 230V, 50Hz is applied to transformer having turns ratio 10:1. The secondary of the transformer is connected to half wave rectifier. The diode has cut-in voltage 0.6V and forward resistance 8$\Omega$. If the load resistance is 400$\Omega$, determine the average and rms values of output current and voltage. What should be the PIV rating of the diode.
For the Zener diode regulator shown, $R_S = 10\Omega$, $V_Z = 10V$, $V_i = 25V$. Find the minimum and maximum current through Zener diode when $R_L$ is varied between 10$\Omega$ and 100$\Omega$.

V_{out} = 0.5V_1 + 1.5V_2 - 0.5V_3 + V_4.
$$

 

Assume $R_F = 10k\Omega$.

questions.markdown: Draw the circuit diagram of an OPAMP non-inverting amplifier and derive the expression for the output voltage. Given $R_F = 10k\Omega$, $R_1 = 5k\Omega$ and the dc supply voltage is $\pm 15V$. Calculate and plot the output voltage with respect to the input, if an input applied is $2\sin(6.28t)$ Volt.
A received (7, 4) Hamming code is 0010001. With even parity, check for errors and if there is an error, write the corrected code. Also represent the transmitted data.

Simplify the following logical expression using K-Map and implement using only NAND gates:

$f(A, B, C, D) = \sum m(5,7,10,13) + \sum d(2,15)$
Implement the logical function $f(x, y, z) = \sum m(0, 3, 6, 7)$ using a 4:1 multiplexer.
Draw the logic diagram of a 3-bit ripple down counter using the negative edge-triggered JK flip flops. Plot the timing diagram for the same.

Given an FM Wave, $S_{FM}(t) = 15\cos[2\pi 10^9 t + 5\sin(2\pi 20000 t)]$.

Calculate:

i) Carrier frequency.
ii) Modulating frequency.
iii) Frequency deviation.
iv) Bandwidth using Carson's rule.
For the given binary data 10011010, sketch ASK, FSK and PSK Signals.
Define the sampling theorem. What is the nyquist sampling rate of the signal $x(t)=3\cos(100\pi t)+10\sin(850\pi t)+5\cos(350\pi t)$.
